title: PoP-ECC: Robust and Flexible Error Correction against Multi-Bit Upsets in DNN Accelerators
problem: Continuous process scaling increases memory error severity and frequency in DNN accelerators, particularly multi-bit upsets (MBUs). Traditional single-error correction codes are insufficient for safety-critical systems.
motivation: Deep neural networks in autonomous vehicles and safety-critical systems require high reliability under aggressive process scaling; strong MBU protection is essential.
method: PoP-ECC protects memory using a two-level checksum system. It first computes checksums (Virtual Parities) from the data, then computes checksums of those checksums (Parities of Parities). This hierarchical nesting lets the system pinpoint and fix multiple simultaneous bit errors while adjusting protection strength based on actual error patterns—all with minimal memory and power overhead.
key_novelty: Hierarchical checksums—creating checksums from checksums—enable flexible, adjustable correction of multiple simultaneous bit errors.
contributions: PoP-ECC two-tier ECC architecture for robust MBU protection in DNN accelerators
Tolerates significantly higher MBU ratios than state-of-the-art solutions
Negligible delay, area, and power overhead
